data.one_liner: Dart and Flutter SDK for Groq AI API inference and chat management
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to integrate Groq's generative AI models into Flutter applications. Supports starting chat sessions, sending messages, setting custom system instructions, and handling errors.
use_when: You want to integrate Groq AI conversational models into a Flutter or Dart app
You need real-time LLM inference speed using Groq models
avoid_when: You require on-device local models instead of a cloud API
You are using a different AI provider like OpenAI or Anthropic and want a dedicated SDK
strengths: Simple API configuration and message handling
Supports custom system instructions and chat history context management
weaknesses: Community project and not officially affiliated with Groq
Relies on an external cloud API requiring an active internet connection and API key
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining a Groq API key and passing it via dart-define or configuration.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using Firebase's Gemini infrastructure for generative AI instead of Groq.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to run Llama models locally on-device rather than calling a cloud API.
